title: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM
subtitle: TensorRT-LLM is the engine under the Inference Fabric. I never touched its kernels; everything I gained came from how work was fed to it, and I tried it first for the capabilities model before closing that path on evidence.

stats.label: tokens a second, five-minute mean across two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, from about 44K on one
input tokens in the long-prompt tiers
the worst weight corruption the vendor conversion caused on affected tensors

lede: Inference Fabric started from stock TensorRT-LLM set up the obvious way, which left most of a consumer GPU idle on bulk generation. My view was that the ceiling sat around the engine, so I kept NVIDIA's kernels and engineered everything else. My C++ layer drives the engine through its Executor API from a Rust service and refuses any engine configuration that leans on defaults, so a mis-sized engine is refused up front. I changed one layer at a time on a 7-billion-parameter dense model in FP8. An engine tier sweep found the per-step token budget to be the largest lever on the engine side, and it is the first lever I measure since.
quote: I get the most from NVIDIA's serving stack by engineering what surrounds it, and I judge it fairly when it does not fit.
evidence: TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM engineering: NVIDIA's kernels kept and everything around them engineered, from about 44K to a 163K tokens-a-second five-minute mean across two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.

Inference serving architecture: per-card engine tiers from one calibrated FP8 checkpoint, up to 4,096 sequences and 524,000 tokens per step on the 32 GB card, each engine carrying a contract of its limits.
Prefix reuse in LLM serving: shared prompt prefixes measured at 40 to 56 percent more throughput on the larger card with 128-token prompts, which is why the broker groups work by prefix.

Vendor technology evaluation: TensorRT-LLM tried first for the capabilities model and closed on three findings, including weights corrupted up to 1,000x by conversion and 56 against 492 requests a second.
author: Corey James
